description: Font tokens for the 'Museum Placard' theme — read directly by scripts/generate-theme-css.cjs (web) and packages/shared/src/theme.ts (mobile). Not run through Style Dictionary: fonts don't vary by light/dark theme, so the per-theme build machinery that colors need doesn't buy anything here.

primary.note: Body/dialogue text. Replaces the app's former sans-serif body font (Inter) and the ad hoc 'Lora' override several components applied on top of it.

secondary.note: Character names, headings, buttons — a quiet, understated serif rather than a showy one, like the type on a museum placard. Replaces the former per-component 'Playfair Display' overrides.

mono.note: Tags, timestamps, eyebrow labels — a typewriter face, like a typed accession card.
